technical-data.invention-title: A TURNING DEVICE FOR FOOD PROCESSING CUTTING MACHINES
DISPOSITIF TOURNANT DESTINE A DES MACHINES DE DECOUPE DE ROBOTS CULINAIRES

abstract.p: A turning device for food processors adapted to cut foodstuffs to be processed. The cutting machine comprises a stationary container (2) fitted with a lid (3), a tubular member (7) which extends up from the container bottom through which a driven shaft (8) extends, a cutting device mounted on the shaft and which includes a sleeve-like central part (10) carrying said cutting tool. The invention is characterised in that the turning device includes at least axially extending strips (14, 15) of a tubular member whose inner diameter exceeds the outer diameter of the central part (10). One end of respective strips (14, 15) extend out from a holder (18). The turning device (13) is fitted to the central part (10) in the position of use with said holder (18) facing upwards. The turning device (13) has a longitudinal extension such as to cover essentially the whole of the central part (10) above the knives (14, 15). The turning device (13) will be stationary relative to the container (2) during operation of the food processor.

L'invention concerne un dispositif tournant destiné à des robots culinaires conçus pour couper des aliments à traiter. La machine à découper comprend un contenant stationnaire (2) équipé d'un couvercle (3), un élément tubulaire (7) qui s'étend de la base du contenant vers le haut et que traverse un arbre d'entraînement (8). Le dispositif comprend également un dispositif de coupe qui est monté sur l'arbre et qui comporte un élément central de type manchon (10) portant l'outil de coupe. L'invention est caractérisée en ce que le dispositif tournant comprend au moins des bandes s'étendant axialement (14, 15) d'un élément tubulaire dont le diamètre interne est supérieur au diamètre externe de l'élément central (10). Une extrémité des bandes respectives (14, 15) fait saillie d'un support (18). Le dispositif tournant (13) est associé à l'élément central (10) dans la position d'utilisation, ce support (18) faisant face vers le haut. Le dispositif de coupe (13) a un profil longitudinal de manière à recouvrir sensiblement tout l'élément central (10) au-dessus des lames (14, 15). Le dispositif de coupe (13) est stationnaire par rapport au contenant (2) pendant le fonctionnement du robot culinaire.

description.p: A TURNING DEVICE FOR FOOD PROCESSING CUTTING MACHINES
The present invention relates to a turning device for food processors of the kind in which the processor is designed as a cutting machine for cutting or chopping the raw foodstuffs to be processed.
Machines of this kind are available in designs for use in industrial kitchens and also in designs for domestic use.

A common feature of these machines is that they include a container which is fitted with a lid that has an infeed opening which allows raw foodstuffs to be inserted into the container whilst the machine is in operation. A tubular member which accommodates a driven shaft extends up from the bottom of the container. A cutting device is non-rotatably fitted to the shaft. The cutting device includes a sleevelike central part which runs on the outside of the upwardly projecting tubular member and which carries the cutting tool at its lower end. The cutting tool may consist in one or more knives that extend radially outwards from the sleeve . The container is held stationary whilst the cutting device rotates, when the machine is in use.

One problem with food processors of this kind is that certain types of ingredients to be processed by the knives tend to fasten to the outer surface of the central part, causing the mass of ingredients to rotate together with said central part .

An example of such agglomerated masses is found in different types of meat that shall be chopped with the aid of the
knives. For instance, meat that is minced tends to form a ball that sticks firmly to the outer surface of the central part and to the inner surface of the container. Consequently, the ball will only rotate around a horizontal axis to a relatively small extent.

This poor rotation of the ball means that the meat will be unevenly chopped. The poor rotation of the meat about a horizontal axis also means the disadvantage that the knives will cut through meat that has already been chopped, causing a local increase in temperature in the meat, which is highly disadvantageous with respect to the quality of the food prepared.
The same problem occurs with other types of food masses that can form a more or less sticky ball, such as fish mince, dough, etc.
The present invention solves this problem.

The present invention thus relates to a turning device for food processors of the kind where the processor is a cutting machine for cutting or chopping raw foodstuffs to be processed, wherein the machine includes a container that is fitted with a lid, said container being stationary during operation of the machine, a tubular member which extends up from the container bottom, a driven shaft which extends through said tubular member, a cutting device which is non- rotatably mounted on said shaft and which includes a sleeve- like central part on the outside of the upwardly extending tubular member and which carries said cutting tool at its lower end, said tool consisting in one or more knives that
extend radially outwards from the sleeve. The invention is characterised in that the turning device includes at least axially extending strips of the outer surface of a tubular member whose inner diameter slightly exceeds the outer diameter of the central part; in that the strips extend at one end thereof from a common holder; in that the turning device is adapted to be fitted to the central part in its position of use, with the holder facing upwards; in that the extension of the turning device in the length extension of the central part is such as to cover essentially the whole of the central part above said knives; and in that the holder is adapted to be supported by the lid or a device connected with said lid, in the position of use of said holder, such that the turning device will be stationary whilst the food processor is operating, or will be rotatable relative to said container only to a limited extent.
The invention will now be described in more detail partly with reference to exemplifying embodiments thereof and also with reference to the accompanying drawings, in which
- Figure 1 is a partially cut-away view of a food processor of the kind with which the invention is applied;
- Figure 2 illustrates a first embodiment of an inventive turning device; - Figure 3 illustrates a lid equipped with an inventive turning device;
- Figure 4 shows the lid of Figure 3 placed on a container;

- Figure 5 is a perspective view of the lid shown in Figure 3, taken obliquely from below; and - Figure 6 illustrates a second embodiment of an inventive turning device .
Figure 1 illustrates a food processor in the form of a food cutting machine which cuts or chops raw foodstuffs that are to be processed. The cutting machine includes a container 2 which is provided with a lid 3 that has a food infeed opening 4 through which raw foodstuffs can be fed into the container whilst the machine is operating. The container 2 remains stationary whilst the machine is operating. A rotary cutting device 5 is mounted above the container bottom. The present invention is intended for application with this type of food processor.

Food processors of this kind include a tubular member 7 which extends up from the bottom 6 of the container 2 and through which a driven shaft 8 extends (see Figure 4) , said shaft 8 having non-rotatably fitted thereto a cutting device 9 which includes a sleeve-like centra] part 10 located on the outside of the upwardly extending tubular member, and which at its lower end carries the cutting tool in the form of one or more knives 11, 12 that extend radially outwards from the sleeve- like part.

According to the invention, the turning device 13 includes at least axially extending strips 14, 15 of the cylindrical surface of a tubular member whose inner diameter slightly exceeds the outer diameter of the central part 10; see
Figures 2 and 4. The strips 14, 15 are held at one end 16, 17 thereof by a holder 18 which is common to said strips.

The turning device 13 is intended to be fitted onto the central part 10 with the holder 18 facing upwards, in the use position of said device.
The extension of the turning device in the longitudinal direction of the central part is such that the device will cover essentially the whole of the central part 10 above the knives 11, 12. Further, the holder 18 is adapted to be carried by the lid 3, or by a device 19 in connection with said lid 3, when the holder is in its use position, such that said turning device 13 will be stationary, or will be rotatable relative to the container 2 only to a limited extent .

According to a first embodiment, the holder 18 is fastened to the lid 3; see Figure 3. The holder may either be an integral part of the lid 3 or may be detachably connected to the lid by means of a typical bayonet fitting (not shown) or with the aid of some other suitable fastener means.

According to a second embodiment of the invention, the holder 18 is fastened to a scrape ring 19 which functions to scrape the vertical inner wall of the container. Such a scrape ring is described in Swedish Patent Specification No. 502 741. A scrape ring of this kind is supported by the upper edge of the container 2. The lid 3 can be fitted onto the scrape ring. Such a scrape ring, and therewith also the turning device, can rotate to a limited extent relative to the container.
A first preferred embodiment of the invention will include the strips as hereinbefore described and illustrated in Figures 2 , 3 , 4 and 5.

According to a second preferred embodiment of the invention, the surface of the tubular member is imperforate, i.e. no
slits are used to form said strips; see Figure 6. In this case, the turning device is comprised of a tubular member 21 which surrounds the central part 10. Similar to the earlier described embodiment, the tubular member 21 may be an integral part of the lid or may be detachably fastened to the lid or carried by a device such as a scrape ring.

The basic function of the turning device is to prevent food mass in the food processor container from sticking to the central part that rotates during operation of the processor. As a result of the presence of the turning device, which is stationary in relation to the container during operation of the processor, the food mass will tend to be rotated in the container solely by the action of the knives. It has been found that greater rotation of the food mass about a horizontal axis on the one hand and a vertical axis on the other is achieved in this way.

This increased rotary movement of the food mass causes said mass to be worked much more uniformly by the knives. Such rotation also prevents the knives from working in one and the same place in said mass, therewith avoiding local increases in temperature.

The embodiment that includes the aforesaid strips has a somewhat greater influence on the rotation obtained by constant impact of the food mass on the strips, as the food mass is driven forwards in the transporting direction of the knives .

The present invention thus solves the problem mentioned in the introduction.
The strips will preferably have a thickness of 2-10 millimetres.
With regard to the embodiment that includes strips 14, 15, it is preferred that the strips are from two to four in number.

It is also preferred that each strip 14, 15 has in a plane perpendicular to the longitudinal axis 22 of the central part 10 an extension around the central part 10 that corresponds to an angle greater than 20° taken in the rotational direction of the central part.

According to one preferred embodiment, the strips 14, 15 are bevelled such that the strip surface 23, 24 that first meets the food mass as said mass is transported around the container by the knives will slope forwardly and downwardly in the transport direction; see Figure 2. This contributes towards rotation of the food mass about a horizontal axis.

Although the invention has been described above with reference to a number of exemplifying embodiments thereof, it will be understood that the invention can be modified with respect to the design of the strips, the attachment of the holder, etc.
It will therefore be understood that the invention is not restricted to said exemplifying embodiments, and that modifications can be made within the scope of the following Claims.

claim.claim-text: 1. A turning device for food processors of the kind with which the processor is a cutting machine adapted to cut or chop raw foodstuffs to be processed, said cutting machine comprising a container (2) fitted with a lid (3), said container (2) being stationary during operation of the machine, a tubular member (7) which extends up from the container bottom and through which a driven shaft (8) extends, a cutting device which is non-rotatably mounted on the shaft and which includes a sleeve-like central part (10) outside the upstanding tubular member, wherewith the lower end of the sleeve-like central part carries said cutting tool in the form of one or more knives (11, 12) which extend radially out from the sleeve (10) , characterised in that the turning device includes at least axially extending strips (14, 15) of the cylindrical surface of a tubular member whose inner diameter slightly exceeds the outer diameter of the central part (10); in that one end of respective strips (14, 15) extend out from a holder (18) which is common to said strips; in that the turning device (13) is adapted to be fitted to the central part (10) in the position of use with said holder (18) facing upwards; in that the turning device (13) has an extension in the longitudinal extension of the central part such as to cover essentially the whole of the central part (10) above the knives (14, 15) ; and in that the holder (18) is intended to be supported by the lid (3) in the use position of said holder, or by a device (20) in connection with said lid, such that the turning device (13) will be stationary relative to the container (2) during operation of the food processor, or will be rotatable relative to the container only to a limited extent.
2. A turning device according to Claim 1, characterised in that the strips (14, 15) are from two to four in number.
3. A turning device according to Claim 1, characterised in that the cylindrical surface of said tubular member (21) is imperforate and slit-free.
4. A turning device according to Claim 1 or 2 , characterised in that the strips (14, 15) have a thickness of 2-10 millimetres.

5. A turning device according to Claim 1, 2 or 4 , characterised in that each strip (14, 15) has a plane perpendicular to the longitudinal axis (22) of the central part (10) that has an extension around the central part which corresponds to an angle greater than 20° taken in the rotational direction of said central part (10) .

6. A turning device according to Claim 1, 2 or 5, characterised in that the strips (14, 15) are bevelled so that the strip surface (23, 24) that is first met by food mass as said mass is transported around in the container (2) by the knives (11, 12) will slope forwardly and downwardly in the mass transporting direction.
7. A turning device according to Claim 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6, characterised in that the holder (18) is fastened in said lid (3) .

8. A turning device according to Claim 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 or 6, characterised in that said holder (18) is fastened to a
scrape ring (20) intended for scraping the vertical inner wall of the container (2) .
